principle: The ten canonical top-level bounded contexts remain the stable owners. Publicly they are projected as Dwellings; nested Rooms delegate scope inside a parent Dwelling and do not create a second owner for the same fact family.
admission_rule: A nested Room should have a distinct task/vocabulary or specialist representation, enough internal material to navigate, and clear interfaces. If it cannot state its boundary, keep it a Path, View, Programme, Field, Collection or topic instead.
